title: Session night: the layout room
lede: A walk through the room on a session night, from the crew lounge to the dispatcher's desk, the yards, the scale, and the paperwork, then the control panels the dispatcher works. Track plans and build photos are under The Build; historical photographs of the island are on the Photos page under History & Industries.

items.title: Power districts, day one
